title: RAW Test Bundle
description: Schema for raw-test-author bundles consumed by scripts/run_raw_tests.py (headless) and the network-troubleshooter agent in test mode. Canonical reference bundle: intelligence-artifacts/AD000002-bgp-neighbor-admin-shutdown-xr/tests/RAW000002-BGP_NEIGHBOR_ADMIN_SHUTDOWN_REPAIR.tests.yml

schema_version.description: Bundle schema version. Always the string "1.0.0".

raw_id.description: RAW identifier. Draft bundles use RAW000000; published bundles use the allocated RAW######.

raw_path.description: Path to the RAW YAML this bundle exercises. Relative to the bundle file (typically '../RAW######-<slug>.yml').

fs_path.description: Path to the paired FS YAML. Relative to the bundle file (typically '../FS######-<slug>.yml').

default_approvals.description: Approval defaults applied when a test does not override.

name.description: snake_case test identifier, unique within the bundle.

source.description: Provenance of the CLI fixtures. raw-test-author always emits 'synthetic'.

mode.description: RAW execution mode. 'hybrid-reasoning' tests are skipped by the headless runner (xfail).

agent_only.description: If true, the headless Python runner skips this test (e.g. approval-denial paths the interpreter itself never sees).

webex_notify.description: Per-test override for Webex notifications in the agent runner. Defaults to true.

alert_vars.description: Variables the FMS would extract from the FS match and pass as RAW inputs.

kb_context_override.description: Optional hermetic KB variables merged into the interpreter variable store. When set, the agent skips the live kb-reader call.

ia_artifacts_override.description: Optional hermetic IA-artifacts override. Reserved for future use.

responses.description: Canned CLI fixtures keyed by (step_id, command), with command-only fallback.

step_id.description: Matches a step.step_id in the RAW. Must be a string, not an integer.

log_entries.description: Synthetic log-buffer fixtures consumed by eval_logs validations. Entries without timestamps are treated as within lookback_time.

step_path.description: Exact ordered list of step_id values the RAW must traverse.

action_ids.description: Exact ordered list of action_select entry IDs (e.g. '1a', '2b') the RAW must select.

must_visit.description: Partial assertion: every listed step_id must appear on the path (order not enforced).

must_not_visit.description: Partial assertion: no listed step_id may appear on the path.

variables.description: Workflow variables expected to hold these values at termination.

webex_events.description: Optional ordered subset of webex-notify event names the agent runner must emit.
